title: 🌈 Animated Underline Loader with CSS Magic ✨
description:
I’ve created an Animated Underline Loader using HTML and CSS! This sleek project features a bold "Loading..." text with a colorful underline that grows from left to right in a smooth, infinite loop. It’s a stylish, lightweight way to show loading progress without JavaScript! 🚀

  • What’s it about? A text loader with a dynamic underline that animates using a CSS gradient and background-size trick.

  • The result? A modern, eye-catching loading effect that feels polished and lively.

  • Main key of the code: The @keyframes animation expands the background-size of a gradient underline, paired with linear-gradient for a clean look.

  • How can users benefit? Add it as a chic loading indicator, tweak the timing, colors, or text to suit your site, or learn CSS animation basics!
shortDescription: 💡 A "Loading..." text with a growing underline, built with pure CSS. Sleek and simple!
